source.timeline: Issue #47724 reports that two clean greedy runs are stable but a third run can diverge without an error while additional tenant configurations are accepted at runtime. PR #47725 narrows this to stale Punica metadata after LoRA slot reassignment. The instruction stops at the earlier output-divergence report.

instruction_contract.starting_point: A user-visible deterministic output divergence during background runtime profile updates, before the affected subsystem or mechanism was identified.
reproduction_summary: Run two long greedy requests twice without runtime updates and save each response.
Run the same requests again while repeatedly adding two other customer setups through the runtime update API.
Compare each response with its own clean reference; affected builds diverge only during background updates and report no error.
instruction_contract.environment_note: The original GPU model and serving harness are not bundled. The agent is asked to construct the smallest local reduction from the pinned source.

behaviors: unchanged requests keep the requested customer customization after active-state replacement
repeated requests without state changes and ordinary request-profile changes remain correct
single-profile, no-profile, registration-only, replacement, reversed-order, repeated-profile, and repeated-cycle controls remain correct
verifier_contract.collection_integrity: Exactly 10 unique cases; Oracle requires zero failures, errors, or skips.

adversarial_runs.planned_defect: Sorting adapter IDs misses slot-order swaps.
Registration is not the activation-time slot reassignment boundary.
Only the first mapping call is refreshed.

conforming_alternative_run.change: Invalidates the old mapping at the activation boundary instead of storing Golden's slot-layout tuple.

hidden_end_to_end.entrypoint: real LRUCacheLoRAModelManager activation and set_adapter_mapping with CPU PunicaWrapper metadata
hidden_end_to_end.hidden_variations: Three-token repeated profiles, reversed request order, no-profile tokens, and repeated replacement cycles are absent from the instruction example.
hidden_end_to_end.execution_substitutions: Synthetic rank-2 CPU LoRA weights replace a downloaded model and GPU inference; the production manager, LRU cache, LoRA layers, distributed world-size-one setup, and Punica metadata run for real.
hidden_end_to_end.limitation: The verifier proves the routing-metadata corruption boundary, not the original HTTP live-update endpoint or downstream GPU token generation.

critical_review_rounds: issue and PR timeline separated into user-visible output divergence, internal diagnosis, and final fix
instruction and task identity rewritten without agent-visible LoRA, hot-load, slot, routing, or Golden mechanism terms
both curator reproduction files removed from the final filesystem, image history, and all 15 retained image layers
Oracle, implementation-independent alternative, three partial fixes, regressions, Git, dependencies, and network checked
five-round stability, hashes, warm digest, retained image, and final Harbor result checked

harbor.checksum_scope: Harbor hashes the task directory. This successful input predates the final evidence refresh and C7 status update; every executable artifact is hash-pinned above.
